title: Mukhyamantri Kanya Sumangala Yojana (MKSY)
administering_authority: Department of Women and Child Development, Government of Uttar Pradesh
beneficiary_groups: Families with Annual Income up to 3 Lakh
summary: Mukhyamantri Kanya Sumangala Yojana is a conditional cash transfer scheme in Uttar Pradesh providing financial assistance across six milestone life stages (birth, vaccination, class 1, class 6, class 9, and degree/diploma admission) totaling ₹25,000 per girl child.

benefits.description: Six-stage conditional financial grant totaling ₹25,000 (revised from earlier ₹15,000): Stage 1 (Birth): ₹5,000; Stage 2 (Full immunisation up to 1 yr): ₹2,000; Stage 3 (Admission to Class 1): ₹3,000; Stage 4 (Admission to Class 6): ₹3,000; Stage 5 (Admission to Class 9): ₹5,000; Stage 6 (10th/12th pass & 2+ yr degree/diploma admission): ₹7,000.
conditions: Maximum 2 girl children per family eligible (or 3 in case of twin delivery on second pregnancy)
Family annual income from all sources must not exceed ₹3,00,000
Must be permanent resident of Uttar Pradesh

rules.explanation: Applicant family must be permanent residents of Uttar Pradesh.
Maximum annual family income from all sources must not exceed ₹3,00,000.
The beneficiary child must be a female.
Maximum two girl children per family are eligible (third girl admissible if twins in second delivery).

required_documents.name: Aadhaar Card of Parent/Guardian and Child
UP Domicile / Permanent Residence Certificate
required_documents.condition: Proof of permanent residence in Uttar Pradesh (Ration card / Voter ID / Electricity bill)

required_documents.name: Income Certificate
required_documents.condition: Certifying family annual income up to ₹3,00,000

required_documents.name: Bank Passbook
required_documents.condition: Active bank account of parent/guardian or girl child for DBT

required_documents.name: Milestone Proof (Birth Certificate / Immunization Card / Admission Certificate)
required_documents.condition: Required according to the specific stage applied for

application_steps.description: Visit official MKSY portal (https://mksy.up.gov.in) and click on Citizen Service Portal.
Register by providing name, mobile number, and Aadhaar details; verify OTP.
Log in and select the appropriate milestone category for the girl child.
Upload scanned documents including residence proof, income certificate, bank passbook, and stage-specific certificate.
Submit application for verification by Block Development Officer / SDM / District Probation Officer.

source_records.publisher: Women and Child Development Department, Government of Uttar Pradesh
